capability.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model for text reasoning, programming and document analysis.
capability.problem_space: Text reasoning model for analytical and programming tasks, including mathematical reasoning, code generation, document analysis and tool-assisted problem solving. This SGAR entry retains text input and text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources or modify files. The published V4.1 Flash family uses an asymmetric MoE architecture with 552 billion base parameters and 8 billion input / 16 billion output active parameters. Published benchmark improvements do not establish measured quality or latency on the configured supplier route.
